task: Render CLI Analytics Tool Success as an em dash instead of 0% when the selected sessions contain no tool calls, across the Overview Summary subtitle, the Users per-user detail column and the user modal Summary tile, while preserving a real 0% whenever tool calls exist.

component_scope.label: M
component_scope.affected: cli-analytics format.ts (new formatToolSuccess helper), views/UsersView.tsx (ToolSuccessRateCell renderer + buildUserMetrics modal tile), views/OverviewView.tsx (buildHeadlineMetrics total_tool_calls subtitle), plus three co-located test suites (format.test.ts, UsersView.test.tsx, OverviewView.test.tsx)

requirements_clarity.label: S
requirements_clarity.gaps: Ticket enumerated the three target surfaces and the keep-real-0% rule explicitly, but was filed against backend behaviour while the defect lived entirely in the frontend render paths; scope boundary for the sibling surfaces (Repositories table, branch rows, session detail) was not stated and was resolved by leaving them untouched as outside the AC. A review pass also found AC2 (real 0% preserved) was initially uncovered on the Overview surface.

technical_risk.label: S
technical_risk.risk_factors: Overview does not route through the shared helper, so the guard is duplicated as an inline conditional and can drift; guarding on the rate instead of the tool-call counter would silently dash a genuine 0% (all calls failed); the modal tile carries a pre-formatted string, so declaring it ColumnType.NUMBER with MetricFormat.PERCENTAGE would run Number('—').toFixed(2) and render NaN%; backend _pct could emit null, which would have crashed Overview and been coerced to 0 on the Users surfaces
technical_risk.mitigation: Branch on the tool_calls counter rather than the rate, with dedicated tests pinning the real-0% case on both the helper and the Overview surface; declare the modal metric as ColumnType.STRING with no format, matching the existing SessionBody m() convention; nullish-coalesce rate and counter in the helper; pure presentational change with no persisted state, so rollback is a revert

key_reasoning.reason: Three production components changed (one new 7-line pure helper in format.ts, two call-site swaps in UsersView.tsx, one inline conditional in OverviewView.tsx) covering three user-visible surfaces, but all within a single UI layer and a single feature folder. Roughly 15 production lines of the 206 insertions.

6 files modified, 0 new, spanning three directories inside one feature folder. Most of the diff is test work: 10 new cases plus rewiring the Table, ExtendedSessionsModal and MetricCard mocks so they invoke the real renderers instead of rendering only developer_name / title / value.

Acceptance criteria named the three surfaces and the keep-real-0% rule, so no stakeholder alignment was needed; the only genuine gap was repo attribution (filed on the backend, fixed in the frontend) and the unstated boundary around sibling surfaces.

Precedent already existed in the same module (formatDuration and truncateModelName both dash) and the change is presentational and trivially revertible; the non-zero score reflects the real-0% guard-direction trap and the Metric ColumnType declaration trap, both caught in review and fixed.
